purpose: The GET route open_reader navigates ReadCapability's page to immediately after creation, before returning the capability, establishing a same-origin document before any fetch-based operation (search/read_rows) runs.
notes: docs/recovery/PORTAL_CONTRACT.md §3 attests the mission-search page's logged-in markers, not that this exact route is a confirmed navigable entry point on the real portal -- treated as recovered evidence, not a G5-approved contract. A page that has never navigated stays at about:blank (opaque/null origin); a fetch() from that origin to any host is cross-origin and is rejected by the browser's own Same-Origin Policy unless the target sends matching CORS headers, independent of and prior to the portal interception policy. Navigating to this route first makes every subsequent fetch same-origin. mcma.portal.capabilities never hardcodes this path: open_reader requires the caller to supply exactly one reviewed GET contract with capability='read' and operation_type='search_page' in its policy and navigates to whatever route that contract names.
